description: This is a shell script for testing HTTP proxy functionality within a Git environment. It sets up tests for cloning repositories through proxies with various configurations, including authentication, SOCKS proxies, and URL encoding checks.

methods.name: start_socks
methods.description: Starts a SOCKS proxy server and signals readiness via a FIFO.

methods.name: old_libcurl_error
methods.description: Checks if the error message indicates an unsupported libcurl version for proxy path support.
